name: click.kaminari/mcp
title: Kaminari Click
description: Traffic-quality statistics, saved/shared reports, and IP/UA reference databases from Kaminari Click.

environmentVariables.name: KAMINARI_CLICK_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: MCP / Agent token from the Kaminari Click account settings (not the regular API token).

environmentVariables.name: KAMINARI_CLICK_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: API base URL. Defaults to https://kaminari.click.
